groups.name: CONTROL
groups.entry_filter: frozen V2 contract plus exact PIT COMMON identity and shared permanent exclusions; no alignment or market-cap restriction

groups.name: ALIGNMENT_MCAP_500B
groups.entry_filter: signal-day adjusted close > prior completed monthly MA20 > prior completed monthly MA60 AND exact signal-date KRX market_cap >= 500000000000 KRW

monthly_alignment.window_gap_policy: reject as MA_UNAVAILABLE; never fill missing bars

market_cap.authority: local immutable KRX raw date-market partition
market_cap.identity: exact PIT ticker + standard ISU_CD + market
market_cap.unresolved_policy: reject candidate signal and record reason; no date or source substitution

universe.eligibility: COMMON interval active on signal date
universe.permanent_exclusion_matching: exact (ticker, standard ISU_CD), shared before group split

portfolio.cash_shortage: skip full order; do not regenerate signal ledger
portfolio.sale_proceeds_available: next normal exact KRX trading session

valuation.daily_nav: available cash + unsettled sale proceeds + held whole shares times exact adjusted close
valuation.carry: only exact officially evidenced non-trading placeholder; otherwise whole-day NAV unresolved
valuation.cutoff_positions: mark to last valid adjusted close; no hypothetical exit or sell costs

preliminary_gates.A_integrity: zero material structural errors; potentially material unresolved source/valuation evidence is CHECK_REQUIRED
preliminary_gates.B_costs: all filled sides include 0.015% commission and 0.1% adverse slippage; transaction tax excluded
preliminary_gates.D_mdd: both groups MDD >= -40%; candidate fails when CONTROL MDD - candidate MDD >= +5.0 percentage points
